source.citation: Schou et al. (1998), ApJ 505:390-417, DOI 10.1086/306146; analytic helioseismic fit as used by Dikpati & Charbonneau (1999), ApJ 518:508-520, DOI 10.1086/307269.
source.source_version: published analytic fit to helioseismic rotation profile

representation.basis: Omega0(theta)=c0+c2*cos(theta)^2+c4*cos(theta)^4, evaluated at the tachocline-center radius of the cited helioseismic fit where the radial transition factor is 1/2

validity.derivation: At the fit transition center, erf(0)=0, so Omega0/2pi = 0.5*(432.8 + 460.7 - 62.69 cos^2(theta) - 67.13 cos^4(theta)) nHz.

outcome_independence.selection_basis: Externally published helioseismic differential-rotation fit frozen before any BURGAMOTS physical response run.
